Here's a summary of what I did with your profile based on this conversation:

**Updated:**
- **Claims workflow redesign (A-001)** — enriched with the details you gave: your contribution (workshops with claims/fraud/tech teams, process mapping, functional requirements, API payload input), the outcome (claim-registration time down from ~18 to ~7 minutes, ~120 handlers using it), and the period (first release live Nov 2025). Added related skills: process mapping, cross-functional workshop facilitation, API requirements definition.
- Added a new skill: **"Cross-team coordination with engineering"** — reflecting your corrected description of coordinating with the engineering manager and tracking dependencies.

**Held back:**
- Your initial statement that you "managed the entire engineering team of eight" — you walked this back, clarifying the engineering manager owned the team and you only coordinated/tracked dependencies. Per the retraction, I only recorded the corrected version, not the original management claim.
- The **cloud architecture certification** — the verification registry timed out, so I couldn't confirm a single matching credential. I didn't add it to your profile. I've asked you for the exact certification name/issuing body so I can verify and record it properly once you reply.
